title: [3.x] Editor crash scanning for file changes while editing shader in 32bit Godot 3.

milestone.title: 3.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 3 release.

body:
### Tested versions

v3.7.dev.custom_build [422158f61] (Shortly after 3.6 release)

### System information

Windows 10 GLES3

### Issue description

I frequently get crashes in the Godot 3 editor due to imports and shader edits.  I believe running the 32bit version catches a lot of problems due to resource leaks and the like.  Not sure if they still happen in 4.x, as I'm running a 64bit build, which is far less likely to run out of memory from leaks.

```C++

        } else { // failed to start thread
            _Thr._Id = 0;
            _Throw_Cpp_error(_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_TRY_AGAIN); <- Exception thrown here.
        }
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Run a 32bit build of the Godot 3 editor.
- Have a large project with lots of resources.
- Repeatedly make changes to a shader causing it to re-compile.
- (Might be a slightly different crash, but modifying a bunch of high-res textures causing them to reimport also results in stability issues)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I think the project needs to be fairly large to reproduce this, so I don't think I can have a small MRP.
